name: performance_advisor
description: Identifies performance bottlenecks, algorithmic inefficiencies, unnecessary memory allocations, I/O blocking patterns, and scalability limitations in source code. Use when a developer is experiencing slowness, high resource usage, or wants to scale their code to handle more load.

input_schema.query: string — the performance problem or scalability goal
input_schema.code: string — the source code to analyse

output_schema.estimated_improvement: string — rough improvement potential (e.g. '10x faster' or '50% less memory')
output_schema.priority_fix: string — the single highest-impact optimisation to implement first
